context: Tests whether the agent follows AEM EDS JavaScript conventions when implementing block decoration. Covers the required export, DOM manipulation practices (re-use elements, scoped queries, no innerHTML, no orphan elements), staying inside the block, and variant handling. Style rules enforced by the project's ESLint config are not scored.

checklist.name: Default export decorate
checklist.description: The block JS file uses `export default function decorate(block)` or `export default async function decorate(block)` as the function declaration

checklist.name: Scoped DOM queries
checklist.description: All DOM queries inside decorate use `block.querySelector()` or `block.querySelectorAll()`, NOT `document.querySelector()` or `document.querySelectorAll()`

checklist.name: No innerHTML for structures
checklist.description: The JS file does NOT use `innerHTML` assignment to build multi-element DOM structures (simple text-only innerHTML may be acceptable, but complex structures must use DOM APIs)

checklist.name: Element reuse not recreation
checklist.description: Existing DOM elements from authored content (images, headings, paragraphs) are moved/reused rather than having their content extracted and placed into freshly created duplicate elements

checklist.name: No orphaned elements
checklist.description:
When elements are transformed (e.g., a `

` converted to a `

`), the original element is removed from the DOM (via replaceWith, remove, or replaceChildren) rather than left as an empty orphan alongside the new element

checklist.name: No global DOM mutation
checklist.description: The block JS does NOT select or modify DOM elements outside of its block scope (e.g., does NOT call `document.querySelector('header')` to modify the page header)

checklist.name: variant check via classList
checklist.description: If variant handling is present, it uses `block.classList.contains('variant-name')` to check for variants
